title: GPU PCIe link drops from Gen5 x16 to Gen4 x8 with thousands of replay errors

expected.reason: Host link bandwidth falls to a quarter and replay (retransmit) errors climb ~1.4k/min. Data loading for that rank slows, adding ~5% to every step. Often a riser/slot fault that worsens.

glossary.PCIe replay: Packet resent because it failed checksum on the CPU<->GPU link.
